method: Source reading, manual mathematics, AST parsing and hashes only; no reviewed module imported.
manual_checks: Exact positive D validation precedes zero caps
Joint caps accept g>P*D; norm mode derives g=P*D after exact parsing
Nonempty interval follows from h<=P^2/m and h<=P*D
H1=0 selects exact affine endpoint by beta sign
Singleton requires one node without S gate
Noncollapsed S gate uses unchanged outward endpoint decisions
Actual-width grid has mesh and root allowances each <=(internal-1)*h/4
Existing value-rounding reserve and final exact ratio check retained
Returned envelope labels distinguish J_D and E_D; refusals retain costs and no bounds
Runner requires root PASS for exact freeze, checks snapshot hashes before import, and never retries
